body:
## Node editor — style pane explorations

Replace the raw class/JSON **textarea** with structured visual controls — **one control system, three CSS channels** — while the **raw code stays reachable and two-way bound**.

**Today** → 2 freeform textareas for 3 frameworks.
**A1** Tailwind — visual controls ⇄ class chips; editable box-model (24 → `mr-6`, off-scale → `mr-[25px]`).
**B1** MUI — theme-token controls + live `sx`.
**C** Inline — box-model + Layout/Appearance controls + synced declaration rows.
Every panel carries a **Typography** section.

Patterns: alignment grid · DevTools box model & declarations · class chips · Tailwind IntelliSense autocomplete + hover-resolve · token pickers · "panel == output".
